counterevidenceSought: harness control B exercises opted-in+replay-missing with affinity:true, so the affinity-missing+opted-in combination is never exercised by evidence
no second passive notification path exists: notifyCacheCompatIfNeeded (index.ts:4102) is the only warningText consumer and the adaptive-thinking branch is anthropic-messages-only
the doctor/composed surfaces DO report affinity, so the loss is notification-only
adjudicatedFindings.alternativeExplanation: intended trade extending limitation 6 to opted-in channels: chat warnings carry DeepSeek-protocol issues only, affinity stays discoverable via /cache-optimizer compat|doctor
adjudicatedFindings.downgradeTrigger: if the command-surface coverage is deemed sufficient and limitation 6 is extended to opted-in channels, downgrade to P2
